milestone.piece: Preserve independently admitted record proof when all coverage assessments fail
milestone.invariant: A failed coverage assessment cannot discard the original positive review of an independently saved record operation. An admission receipt does not establish completeness, and its empty coverage map cannot bypass a saved complete assessment's reconstruction.
milestone.observable_pass: An accepted correction with both coverage reviews unavailable saves its original source/target/operation proof under explicit v3, retains current successor and superseded original support for later real reviewers, and replays without effects or model calls. Either valid scope keeps existing v2. No positive unit produces no new receipt; independently checked opening remains admissible. Wrong sources, targets, receipt versions and fabricated complete coverage refuse before replay dispatch. Legitimate mechanically partial fallback remains admissible.
